Hello everyone. Glad to see you here in /v/electronicmusic and checking out the tunes. I have a couple of new rules to help listeners discover new music and give this sub a uniformed look and consistent experience. Please check the sidebar for the rules before making a post.

Titling your submission.

Your submission should follow this format:

Individual tracks: Artist(s) - Track (Genre 1/Genre 2) [Year]

Ex. Moby - Mistake (Electronica/Downtempo) [2009]

Album or Compilation: Artist or Producer - Album name (Genre 1/Genre 2) [Year]

Ex. Tiesto - In Search of Sunrise 7: Asia (Trance/Progressive) [2008]

Adding the genres is to help listeners narrow down the style they want to listen to or learn about. There are a million different genres and styles out there and most tracks blends multiple genres but try to get as close to the main style as much as possible. Use this list to help you.

No clickbait or promotional titles.

No titles like 'Check my work!' or 'This tune is sick!' Please don't deviate from the title format. Keep it clean.

I will update the sidebar in the future to improve this sub but for now this will do. Thanks for you cooperation and have a happy listening. :)
